description: An abstract Java class that provides a base implementation for sending messages over AMQP in a client connecting to the Eclipse Hono platform. It includes message sending methods, span management for tracing, and delivery outcome handling.

classes.name: AbstractSender
classes.description: Abstract base class for AMQP message sender implementations, providing core functionality for message dispatch, tracing, delivery handling, and resource management.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a raw AMQP message asynchronously, with optional tracing context.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to send a message, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span for message sending, optionally with a parent context.

methods.name: sendMessageAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the delivery outcome, handling timeouts and delivery states.

methods.name: logMessageIdAndSenderInfo
methods.description: Logs message ID and sender credit/tag information into the current tracing span.

methods.name: logUpdatedDeliveryState
methods.description: Logs details about delivery state updates into the current span, including acceptance or rejection reasons.
